description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Mr. W. P. Ariyadasa  was elected as the Chairman of Urban Council Tangalle
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election result of a specific individual (Mr. Warnakulasuriya Patabendige Ariyadasa) to the position of Chairman of the Urban Council Tangalle. The content is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it primarily concerned with an electoral process and result, which fits the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
